speak.title: Role-play: pineapple on the menu
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A customer wants pineapple on a pizza. Your chef says no. Ask why he refuses and what he wants to do. Decide whether to say yes, say no, or find a middle way.

b.text: You are a proud Italian chef. A customer wants pineapple on a pizza and you think it's wrong. Explain your reasons, but remember that you need your job.

phrases: I'm sorry, but I can't put pineapple on a pizza.
It's not a real Italian pizza.
The customer's always right, you know.
I'd rather lose my job than do it.
Could we offer it on a white pizza?
Let's find a solution we're both happy with.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the chef keep his job, and who gave way first?
